This gives them an address and a mailbox: one session names another and delivers a message into its inbox, which the harness schedules like any other model-facing input. Around that sit the things a pair of agents needs to not waste each other's turns — advisory claims on files, peer verification of claims neither can check alone, a durable decision ledger, task states with deadlock detection, and per-turn accounting of what coordination cost and caught. Arriving messages render as their own card in the Web UI transcript.
